title: Message/set allows zero-length body
description: message.rs process_create checks body.len() > MAX_BODY_BYTES (65536) but has no lower bound. A zero-length body string passes validation and is stored as a message with no visible text. Peer/deliver in kith-peer similarly has no zero-length body check (only the upper bound). A message with an empty body creates an invisible chat entry that clients must handle. Given that the recent fix KITH-bpmo explicitly rejected zero-size attachments to match Peer/deliver behaviour, the same reasoning applies to body: Message/set should require body.len() >= 1 to produce a consistent minimum-size constraint on both the owner-send and peer-deliver paths.
